title: Add browser evidence to CI or documented manual gate
description: Make browser smoke and representative accessibility evidence a repeatable release gate without requiring unavailable local infrastructure silently.
acceptanceCriteria: A documented command starts the disposable app/test database and runs the browser suite, or CI runs it automatically
The gate runs on the staged/prebuilt artifact at least once before publication
Failures produce sanitized logs and a clear manual fallback if a runner is unavailable
The release checklist links to the exact evidence file and records the environment

steps.details: Inspect package manifests and CI capabilities; prefer an existing browser dependency, otherwise document a reproducible manual browser command and do not add an unverified dependency silently.
Add a script or documented command that starts a disposable server, runs representative routes in en/fa, and shuts down cleanly.
Add the gate to the appropriate workflow or release checklist with timeout, artifact retention, and secret-safe logs.
Run the command or its closest available local validation and record the exact limitation if a real browser is unavailable.

technicalNotes: Do not claim browser coverage when only static inspection or unit tests ran.
